decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a certification-heavy niche with long procurement and service cycles, so the firm is likely to keep the line available.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still has its own page and fits the ergonomic office portfolio, though competition in desk lamps is strong and the firm has already shown it will prune lines.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship of the firm's efficient, glare-free office lighting direction, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.

The HMI searchlight's discharge-lamp technology conflicts with the LED push, and the 2024 withdrawal of the sister marine searchlight raises the risk, but marine customers need continuity, so the firm likely keeps it for now.
